source: publication-date carriers on three surfaces of the same listings; cookies, contacts and unrelated session state omitted

itemApi.type: rendered string, Moscow time, no year and no seconds

itemPage.type: the same rendered string with a leading middot

notes: the epoch and the rendered string are the same moment: the string is Moscow time, and the Ulyanovsk listing was rendered in Moscow time too, not in its own
the item surface carries no machine-readable timestamp at all: the epoch 1786662941 does not occur anywhere in the listing document
item.finishTime (1789254941) is the expiry, not the publication, and is the only numeric time field the item API ships
sortTimeStamp is what Avito sorts 'по дате' by, so re-publishing a listing moves it
